goal: Physically model a Fender Rhodes Mark I from evolving mechanical, electromagnetic and circuit states without recorded-note playback.
target: One documented 73-key Mark I Stage specimen at its specified loaded electrical output; identity and measurements pending.

tasks.title: Establish reproducible research and agent foundation
acceptance: Buildable dependency-free research kernel, developer setup and platform CI configuration exist.
Canonical state, evidence validation, generated status and agent continuation workflow pass their tests.
Research scope, synthetic constants, missing measurements and licensing uncertainty are documented.

tasks.title: Identify the reference Mark I Stage specimen
acceptance: Record specimen identity, construction dates or uncertainty, action and pickup condition, and selected loaded-output boundary.
Inspect actual wiring and revision-specific components; reconcile discrepancies with documentary sources.
Use a versioned passport with configuration/replacement history, resolvable inspection artifacts and observed-versus-normalized key identities; retain unknown markings honestly.
blockers: No identified physical specimen or authenticated measurement set has been supplied.

tasks.title: Acquire calibrated specimen data and held-out manifest
acceptance: Acquire synchronized mechanical motion and electrical output with measured geometry, excitation, loads and calibration.
Record units, uncertainty, specimen identity, acquisition conditions, hashes, rights, and independent train/validation splits.
Retain retriggers, release, velocity, pickup-position and loading conditions not used for fitting.
Implement and validate the versioned ingestion contract for calibration validity, raw-byte verification, acquisition groups and derivation ancestry before accepting measured datasets.
blockers: Actual calibrated specimen recordings and motion/impedance measurements are unavailable; templates are not observations.

tasks.title: Validate analytic mechanical and pickup primitives
acceptance: Analytic oscillator propagation agrees with an independent closed-form reference.
Retrigger retains displacement and velocity; pickup differentiates combined modal flux linkage.
Passive network tests include inactive pickup loading; invalid inputs are rejected.
Synthetic parameters and omitted interactions are explicitly labeled.

tasks.title: Implement finite-mass hammer and damper contact reference
acceptance: Use finite hammer mass, reciprocal contact forces, separation and recontact with persistent resonator state.
Model damper/pedal contact and resting equilibrium; identify or label all assumed contact parameters.
Pass energy, timestep convergence, retrigger, release and pedal stress checks with explicit numerical tolerances.

tasks.title: Identify magnetic linkage and reciprocal force reference
acceptance: Identify a smooth flux-linkage map and derivatives across measured displacement, orientation and pickup geometry.
Use consistent energy/co-energy for induced voltage and reaction force; identify permanent-magnet force independently.
Avoid double-counting magnetic effects already present in measured mechanical modes.

tasks.title: Identify and solve the specimen pickup network
acceptance: Verify actual coil membership, topology, component values, parasitics, load and cable.
Include electrically inactive branches and correct loaded boundary; distinguish documentary candidates from specimen facts.
Validate DC, complex impedance, source transfer and energy/current residuals against independent reference calculations and measurements.

tasks.title: Predict held-out behavior of one measured note
acceptance: Predict unseen strike levels, release, retriggers, pickup positions and loads on the identified specimen.
Predeclare numerical, physical, electrical and perceptual acceptance criteria from measurement uncertainty and repeatability.
Record passing and failing conditions with absolute level and timing preserved; report scope without realism percentages.

tasks.title: Expand validated construction zones across all 73 keys
acceptance: Calibrate per-key and construction-zone parameters without hiding discontinuities or resetting repeated notes.
Validate bass/mid/treble, transition notes, shared motion and chords against held-out specimen measurements.
Preserve silent pickup network membership and shared nonlinear circuit processing.

tasks.title: Measure runtime cost and numerical approximation errors
acceptance: Benchmark representative kernels with hardware, compiler, sample rate, block size, polyphony and stress conditions recorded.
Report maximum observed callback duration and deadline misses, plus optimized-versus-reference error.
Verify allocation/locking policy and timestep/antialiasing convergence; claim only measured performance.

tasks.title: Validate the connected passive Stage output controls
acceptance: Identify the actual Stage volume/bass graph, component designators, terminal connections, modifications and correction history.
Measure pot taper, direction, endpoint/wiper behavior and relevant component uncertainty; solve controls with pickup, cable and receiver loading.
Validate gain, phase and input impedance across combined control positions, endpoints and held-out loads with explicit loaded-harp versus Stage-jack identities.
Bind all parameters and assets to the selected specimen/configuration, netlist hash, output boundary and schema version.

tasks.title: Add separately identified optional Suitcase electronics
acceptance: Create verified netlists with component-level provenance and identified device models for a selected circuit revision.
Keep Peterson and Janus/Suitcase profiles distinct from the completed Stage target; validate operating point, dynamic state and shared nonlinear chord behavior.
Resolve documented schematic corrections against physical boards before exactness claims.

tasks.title: Extend the selected boundary to cabinet acoustics
acceptance: Define amplifier/speaker electrical interaction, acoustic listening or microphone boundary and runtime response policy.
Identify and validate electrical, mechanical, radiation and level-dependent effects separately.
Report acoustic validation only for held-out conditions and the specific cabinet/position.

tasks.title: Build and validate an experimental VST3 instrument adapter
acceptance: Bounded sample-offset event processing preserves producer order and physical key state; invalid blocks reject without mutation.
An optional VST3 instrument builds against an explicitly identified public SDK and passes the available SDK validator with bounded audio processing and documented output scaling.
Host configuration round-trips through a versioned validated state format; MIDI range, sustain, overlapping notes, reset and unsupported host conditions are explicit and tested.
Document the actual tested platform and synthetic sound boundary without claiming measured fidelity or an untested release.

tasks.title: Improve VST3 MIDI interoperability and generic control validation
acceptance: Deliver bounded channel-specific CC123 commands with chronological ownership preflight, retained sustain/tails, zero-frame handling and unchanged saved configuration.
Accept validated polyphonic pressure without dropping co-batched note events; reject malformed inputs atomically.
Reject malformed generic-control text and nonfinite conversions without changing output values or saved state.
Pass independent ownership/audio comparisons, compatibility checks and native SDK/module validation for the claimed platforms; document remaining DAW-specific verification.

tasks.title: Add global expression and flexible VST3 output layouts
acceptance: Global CC11 Expression has independent bounded sample-offset automation, strict control conversion, unity default and unchanged legacy-unity audio; mute preserves synthesis, and invalid transactions reject without live mutation.

Adaptive versioned configuration preserves exact 16-byte legacy unity states, supports validated 20-byte expression states and all model identities, and retains coherent bounded lock-free publication under concurrent recall.

Mono and stereo negotiation, exact scalar output, bounded buffer handling, omitted inactive outputs, silence masks and lifecycle behavior pass direct and actual loaded-module checks without changing existing stereo behavior.

Independent integration and legacy comparisons plus relevant core/host checks and all three SDK/module validators pass on Linux, Windows and macOS with source-bound results, explicit skips and no unsupported runtime claims.

User, state-format, build and named-DAW verification documents describe the observed feature scope, compatibility and remaining limits; physical calibration and separate numerical tasks are not promoted.

tasks.title: Build the owner-reference native photo editor and functional panel controls
acceptance: Preserve the supplied original image and implement a native editor using its full composition and aligned controls.
Connect panel controls to bounded synthetic audio processing and coherent state recall while preserving default legacy output.
Verify native editor lifecycle, interaction, resizing and packaged resources; retain actual screenshots and platform-specific results.
